_comment: Japan Ministry of Finance / Customs trade statistics. Everything here is
keyless: static files on customs.go.jp plus e-Stat's public CSV downloads.
Verified 2026-09-02 against live payloads captured by the workflow into
data/japan/raw/ (customs.go.jp is unreachable from the build sandbox).
Release cadence (calendar: https://www.customs.go.jp/toukei/calendar/calend_e.htm):
first 10 days  -> ~28th of the same month, 08:50 JST (press release XML, totals only)
first 20 days  -> ~7th of the next month, 08:50 JST (press release XML, totals only)
monthly prov.  -> ~20th of the next month, 08:50 JST (XML with commodity breakdown)
detailed (D&P) -> end of the next month, 09:30 JST (XML + e-Stat 9-digit CSVs)
Press-release XML file naming, verified against the live site:
trade-st_e/<YYYY>/<YYYYMM><stage>e.xml  (English; Japanese: trade-st/<YYYY>/<YYYYMM><stage>.xml)
stage 1 = first 10 days, 2 = first 20 days, 4 = monthly provisional,
5 = exports detailed / imports 9-digit provisional. 3 does not exist.
e.g. 2026081e.xml (Aug 2026 first 10 days), 2026074e.xml (Jul 2026 monthly).
Root element hodoxml; values in million yen; △ marks negatives; ZENZO/ZENGEN
mark growth from/to zero.
Keyless CSV time series (thousand yen, cp932) under toukei/suii/html/data/.
d41ma.csv: world monthly export/import totals from 1979 (Years/Months,Exp-Total,Imp-Total).
d51ma.csv: world monthly EXPORTS by press-release commodity from 1988; header rows
報道発表品目名 / 概況品名 / 概況品コード / 金額,数量 then YYYY/MM rows, '-' = unpublished.
d61ma.csv: same for IMPORTS. Index: https://www.customs.go.jp/toukei/suii/html/time.htm
e-Stat hosts MOF's monthly CSV tables without a key. 統計品別表 (Values by
Commodity) gives value and quantity per 9-digit statistical code for the
world, one file per month (each file carries Jan..latest of its year).
Navigation (all server-rendered HTML): parent page lists 輸出/輸入 children
(tclass2); the listing page lists year/month links (year=YYYY0&month=<8-digit
code, e.g. July = 23070907>); the month page carries the file id
(stat_infid / statInfId); download_url_template fetches the CSV.
CSV columns: Exp or Imp,Year,HS,Unit1,Unit2,Quantity1-Year,Quantity2-Year,
Value-Year,Quantity1-Jan,Quantity2-Jan,Value-Jan,...,Value-Dec (thousand yen).
tclass2 values below are fallbacks; the fetcher discovers them from the parent page.
